title: The Tailscale client is pinned to a version and checksum, every uses: ref is a full commit SHA, and every workflow declares explicit permissions

criteria.then: it passes tailscale/github-action a concrete version (not latest) and a 64-hex sha256sum

criteria.given: every uses: line in .github/workflows and .github/actions that is not a local or docker reference
criteria.then: its ref is a full 40-character commit SHA (no tags or branches)
it declares a top-level permissions: block, so the repository default token scope is never inherited
